typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit (Do not use Inter). Weight: Bold/Black. Tracking: Tight (-0.02em to -0.04em).
typography.body: Inter or IBM Plex Sans for readability.
typography.mono_accent: JetBrains Mono or Roboto Mono for labels, order references, live progress stats.
typography.hierarchy_rules: H1: fluid 4xl-6xl. H2: 3xl-4xl. Mono overlines: text-xs tracking-widest uppercase.

visual enhancers.surfaces: Use 1px crisp borders (border-border). Avoid muddy shadows. For elevated cards, use subtle drop shadows only in light mode, and inner borders in dark mode.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavy blur (backdrop-filter: blur(16px)) with highly transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or tip boxes. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.
visual enhancers.accents: Use the bright lime (#CCFF00) strictly for primary CTA buttons, live progress bars, and active states. Do not overuse.
visual enhancers.textures: Optional subtle SVG noise overlay on the #0A0A0B background to reduce digital flatness.

component name.DonationCampaignCheckout: Main campaign visual + interactive donation widget. Needs progress bar, stats, supporters list.
component name.StandardPaymentCheckout: Focused, narrow container. Receipt-like order summary. Coin selector grid.
component name.CreatorProfilePage: Public vanity page. Avatar, bio, grid of payment links, sticky tip box.
component name.HandleClaimUI: Settings module. Input with prefix, success/error state for availability.
component name.LandingPageRefresh: Update hero or features section to include creator pages and crowdfunding visuals.

grids.creator_page: Bento Grid: 1 column on mobile. Desktop: 12-column grid. Left 8 cols for active links/bio, Right 4 cols for sticky Tip Box.
grids.donation_checkout: Asymmetrical 2-column. Left: Campaign storytelling (image, text, supporters). Right: Actionable donation form.
grids.standard_checkout: Centered narrow 1-column layout (max-width: 480px). Dense data display.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Sections should have padding like py-24. Cards should have p-6 or p-8.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text. Center standard checkout content. Optically align icons in buttons.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons: slight scale (scale(0.98)) or brightness increase. Progress bars should animate width on load.
motion.transitions: Use MUI transitions or simple CSS `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure black text (#000000) is used ON the primary lime green (#CCFF00) for contrast. Do not use white text on lime.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings for inputs and buttons.

media.rules: Images must have max-h-[50vh] on mobile to prevent blocking UI. Use object-cover for cover images. Avoid fully transparent headers over images.

3d libraries.usage: Not strictly required for checkout/profile pages to maintain performance and focus, but can use mild Framer Motion or CSS animations.

creator_avatar.description: Avatar for the Creator Profile Page mockup.

donation_cover.description: Abstract cover image for the Donation/Crowdfunding Checkout page.

crypto_abstract.description: Dark abstract pattern for Landing Page background accents or standard checkout merchant background.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Use Next.js Pages router (.js files). 2. Use MUI + styled-components. Extend the MUI theme (`theme.palette`) to support the dark (#0A0A0B) and light themes matching the 'Swiss/editorial' vibe. 3. Build a CreatorProfile page component that takes a `handle` prop. 4. Refactor the existing DonationCampaign component to include a live progress bar, stats, supporters list, and dynamic donation options. 5. Do not use generic MUI shadows; use crisp borders and glassmorphism. 6. Integrate `data-testid` on all buttons and inputs. 7. For mono-accent texts (stats, percentages), use `fontFamily: 'monospace'` or a loaded mono font in MUI typography variants.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific transitions. Ensure the 'App' container is not center-aligned to preserve reading flow. Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations). DO NOT use AI emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or MUI Icons. Provide micro-animations for hover states.
